brief: The canvas depicts an ethereal, deep-water scene enveloped in dense, shifting fog. A strong lighthouse beam sweeps across the mist, defining a clear, bright arc. The fog itself drifts slowly, creating subtle, constantly changing gradients of gray and muted blues. As the light cuts through the water surface, the moonlight enhances the effect, causing the reflected beam to fracture. These reflections are not smooth; they appear as countless, sharp, shimmering points of intense color that shimmer and glitter independently, adding a fragmented texture to the otherwise tranquil, sweeping motion of the scene.
